verdict.rationale: Digits documents an "Agentic Close" that collects activity continuously, books transactions, starts reconciliation before month-end, runs quality control, surfaces exceptions with context, and produces reports from the live ledger. That close is backed by AI reconciliation and transaction flagging with smart reviews, and by collaborative review of financials, which covers the story's agent-driven close prepared for human sign-off. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how bank and ledger transaction matching works, a clear description of the human review and sign-off step, and independent or hands-on corroboration; the external MCP server is read-only, so outside agents cannot drive the close themselves.
